title: Patient Care Desk Training: Tenure Allowance on Manufacturer Copay Card Reimbursements — Savings & Copay Assistance Programs
content:
A tenure allowance is added to the Manufacturer Copay Card reimbursement limit per 28 days of supply of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs for the whole months from the date the program was opened to the fill date: **6 months or more** add **50.00 dollars**, **3 to 5 months** add **25.00 dollars**, and fewer add nothing.

**From which date is tenure counted?** From the date the card enrollment was opened, as the enrollment shows it.

**To which date?** To the date of the fill being reimbursed, not to today.

**Whole months only?** Yes; a part month does not count.

| Whole months from opening to the fill date | Allowance added |
|---|---|
| 0 to 2 | $0.00 |
| 3 to 5 | $25.00 |
| 6 or more | $50.00 |

**Hypothetical:** a card opened 5 whole months and some days before the fill date adds $25.00; opened 6 whole months before it, $50.00.
